title: Project Manager
description:
Job Function: Services The role:

Are you driven to lead complex cloud projects across AWS, Azure, and Digital Workplace solutions with exceptional delivery outcomes?
Do you excel at balancing scope, schedule, budget, and quality to deliver high\-impact results in a fast\-paced project environment?
If you could drive successful cloud projects end\-to\-end using proven delivery frameworks, how would you make an impact?  

We are looking for a motivated Cloud Project Manager to join our xDC India team. This position plays a crucial role in overseeing professional services engagements concerning Cloud Services like AWS, Azure, and Digital Workplace (M365\). As a Cloud Project Manager, you will play a key role in achieving our projects' objectives by guaranteeing they achieve scope, schedule, achievements, budget, and quality expectations through detailed planning, control, and implementation following SoftwareOne's Project Delivery Framework and established processes.* Lead end\-to\-end project delivery by coordinating the Sales\-to\-Delivery handover and guiding project teams toward successful outcomes.
* Plan, manage, and control projects to ensure alignment with scope, timelines, cost, and quality objectives.
* Drive project governance and execution by developing deliverables, managing financials, and maintaining healthy profit margins.
* Maintain strong client communication by managing delivery relationships, resolving conflicts, and providing regular Project Status Reports.
* Lead and mentor teams by supporting junior members’ development while managing multiple parallel projects with a target of over 75% chargeability.
* Ensure operational excellence by promoting knowledge sharing, leveraging cross\-project insights, and proactively managing Change Requests and project variances.
* Drive compliance and organizational alignment by supporting SwoDP project administration, enforcing time/effort tracking and forecasting, and achieving bi\-annual performance and development goals.


What we need to see from you:
* Experience in core Project Management role and/or holding a PMP/Prince two Practitioner certification (or eligibility to acquire certification within the first year of employment)
* Proficiency in crafting Project Plans using Microsoft Project Professional (MPP)
* Experience working on AWS, Azure or M365 projects, such as Landing Zone build, server migration, database migration, tenant\-to\-tenant migration, Intune setup, GSuite to M365 migration, etc.
* Solid interpersonal skills, including attention to detail and multitasking capabilities. Structured, organized, proactive, well\-adapted, and methodical approach.
* Technical certifications preferred, e.g., AWS Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, M365 Fundamentals, Security, Compliance and Identity Fundamentals, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, etc.
* Experience in using tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, Planner, Smartsheet, and/or other project governance tools.


Join us in this ambitious role and become part of a team that thrives on delivering flawless solutions and outstanding service! At SoftwareOne, your expertise will help craft the future of cloud services and drive unparalleled success.
Why SoftwareOne?:

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.
  

  

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast\-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.
  

  

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.
Accommodations:
SoftwareOne welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you require reasonable adjustments at any point during the recruitment process, email us at reasonable.accommodations@softwareone.com.
Please include the role for which you are applying and your country location. Someone from our organization that is not part of the decision\-making process will be in touch to discuss your specific needs and we will make every effort to accommodate you. Any information shared will be stored securely and treated in the strictest of confidence in line with GDPR.

At SoftwareOne, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Additionally, we encourage experienced individuals that have taken an intentional career break and are now prepared to return to work to explore our SOAR program.

description:

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and organized **Project Manager Intern** to support our growing team in planning, coordinating, and tracking multiple projects. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with different teams, communicating with clients/freelancers, and ensuring projects are delivered on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Strong communication and follow\-up skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Problem\-solving and analytical mindset.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint, and documentation tools**.
* Familiarity with **Jira, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, or similar tools** is a plus.

Who Can Apply

* Students or recent graduates pursuing **MBA, BBA, BCA, B.Tech, or related programs**.
* Candidates interested in **Project Management, Product Management, Operations, or Business Management**.

What You’ll Gain

* Exposure to **client management, freelancer management, project planning, and delivery**.

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**


We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**


Advisor, Technical Project Management**About your role:**


As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience you'll need to have:**

* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes

**How you'll work:**

* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:**


Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

**Note to agencies:**


Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

**Warning about fake job posts:**


Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Academy - Project Management Lead
description:
**What Cognite is:****Relentless****to achieve**
================================================



Cognite operates at the forefront of **industrial digitalization, building AI**, and data solutions that solve the world's hardest, highest\-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low\-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.



We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward \- not backwards \- you'll feel right at home here.



Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

  

**How you'll demonstrate** **Ownership**
========================================

  

**About the Role**
------------------



Cognite Academy is looking for a highly organized and execution\-focused **Senior Project Lead – Academy Content \& Operations** to drive the day\-to\-day execution of our training content development initiatives.



This role will be responsible for ensuring that content development projects move from planning to completion on time, with clear ownership, strong cross\-functional coordination, and minimal execution friction.



You will work closely with instructional designers, technical content developers, trainers, product experts, and subject matter experts (SMEs) across Cognite. You will establish project plans, maintain execution cadence, track deliverables and dependencies, proactively identify risks, and follow up with stakeholders to keep projects moving.



This is an **individual contributor role** with significant responsibility for driving accountability and execution across the Academy team.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Project Planning \& Execution**


* Own the end\-to\-end project management of Academy content development initiatives.
* Translate content development priorities into clear project plans, milestones, and deliverables.
* Establish and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly execution rhythms across active projects.
* Ensure every project has clearly defined tasks, owners, deadlines, dependencies, and status.
* Track project progress against agreed timelines and proactively address schedule risks.
* Maintain a consolidated view of all active content development projects and their health.
* Drive projects through to completion rather than simply tracking and reporting progress.


**Team Coordination \& Accountability**


* Coordinate closely with Academy team members to ensure weekly commitments and project tasks are clearly defined and updated.
* Follow up proactively on overdue or at\-risk deliverables and help remove obstacles affecting execution.
* Facilitate regular project check\-ins, stand\-ups, and status reviews as required.
* Ensure project management systems remain accurate and reflect the latest status, ownership, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Create visibility into upcoming milestones, workload, risks, and potential bottlenecks.


**Cross\-Functional \& SME Coordination**


* Coordinate with Product, Professional Services, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams to secure SME participation required for Academy projects.
* Schedule and manage SME engagements, reviews, technical validation sessions, and content approvals.
* Follow up with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure dependencies are completed on time.
* Identify cross\-functional blockers early and proactively work with stakeholders to resolve them.
* Escalate unresolved risks and dependencies with clear context, impact, and recommended actions.


**Project Governance \& Reporting**


* Establish consistent project management practices across Academy content development.
* Maintain project dashboards, trackers, risk logs, action registers, and project documentation.
* Provide concise weekly status reporting covering progress, upcoming milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
* Identify recurring execution bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Help improve the predictability and scalability of Academy's content development operations.

**The** **Impact** **you bring to Cognite**
===========================================


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


* Academy content projects have clear plans, owners, milestones, and deadlines.
* Weekly commitments are visible and consistently followed through.
* Project risks and delays are identified before they become critical.
* SMEs and cross\-functional dependencies are engaged early enough to avoid project delays.
* Team members spend less time chasing dependencies and coordinating logistics.
* Leadership has clear visibility into project health, risks, capacity, and delivery timelines.
* Content development projects are completed predictably and on time.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 5\+ years of experience in project management, program coordination, program operations, or a similar execution\-focused role.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with both team members and senior stakeholders.
* Strong ability to drive follow\-through and accountability across teams without having direct reporting authority.
* Advanced knowledge of modern project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of project management practices including milestone planning, dependency management, risk management, capacity planning, status reporting, and escalation.
* Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to identify blockers, facilitate decisions, and proactively move projects forward.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with multiple stakeholders and changing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience managing training, learning content, technical documentation, product education, or content development projects.
* Experience working with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, or other technical teams.
* Familiarity with instructional design or technical training development processes.
* Experience building dashboards and reporting mechanisms for portfolio/project visibility.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or similar project management certification is beneficial but not required.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------


* **Execution Discipline** – Creates structure, maintains momentum, and drives projects through completion.
* **Communication** – Communicates clearly, concisely, and confidently across functions and levels.
* **Ownership** – Takes responsibility for outcomes rather than simply documenting project status.
* **Influence Without Authority** – Builds relationships and drives accountability across stakeholders without relying on reporting structures.
* **Proactive Problem Solving** – Identifies risks and blockers early and works actively to resolve them.
* **Organization \& Attention to Detail** – Maintains accurate project plans and ensures commitments do not fall through the cracks.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** – Builds productive relationships with SMEs and stakeholders across the organization.

**Role Scope**
--------------



This is an individual contributor role and does not have direct people\-management responsibility. The role owns the execution and coordination of Academy projects, while functional leaders and content owners remain accountable for their respective subject\-matter and content decisions.

  


**Learn more about us**  



* Impact 2025
* Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
* We're globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

  


***Equal Opportunity***
*Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.*

MEICON is adding a Project Engineer with specializations in Civil and Construction Engineering to our fastgrowing team. As a Project Engineer, the individual will be part of an ever\-growing organization executing Highrise Residential projects in India \& has enormous potential for career growth.

**Location:** *Gattahalli, Bangalore, Karnataka.*

MEICON is a cutting\-edge construction \& Project management firm specializing in infrastructure development. Our team of professionals has extensive experience in civil and electrical work functions, including Estimation, Design, Planning and Scheduling, Project Management,Contract, Quality, Operations, and Maintenance management.

**Skills \& Responsibilities:**

* Managing entire construction projects and organizing and managing the timely mobilization of resources on\-site, ensuring alignment with the client's defined time, cost, and quality objectives.
* Conduct regular and thorough site inspections to verify that all construction works are being executed in strict compliance with the project's contract specifications and quality standards.
* Overseeing construction work from scratch to completion of project.
* Conduct and facilitate regular weekly site meetings with contractors and consultants to ensure effective communication, track progress, address issues, and maintain timely delivery of work.
* Undertaking surveys as required on site.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive construction schedule, including detailed two\-week and one\-month look\-ahead schedules for each contractor, updated bi\-weekly, to ensure accurate progress tracking and proactive management of potential delays.

* Take lead responsibility for the review, monitoring, coordination, and resolution of all defects with the Main Contractor and nominated subcontractors during the defects liability period, ensuring all repairs are completed to the client's satisfaction.

* Establishing standards for final acceptance during the defects liability period and work completion prior to final acceptance.
* Generate and manage Requests for Information (RFIs), ensuring timely responses and proper closure, and maintain comprehensive records of all RFI activities.
* Prepare punch lists, indicating the items of work remaining to be accomplished and ensure that these items are completed in an expeditious manner.
* Co\-ordinate and expedite the preparation by the trade contractors of operating and maintenance manuals and similar instructions.
* Organize and coordinate manufacturer representative services to provide on\-site personnel with comprehensive training on all major equipment.
* Expedite the timely preparation and submission of accurate as\-built drawings from all trade contractors to the client upon project completion, as per specifications.
* Experience in executing complex residential projects and setting out sites.
* Determines project costs by calculating labor, material, and related costs.
* Coordinating and instructing the manpower to conduct the works as per standard codes and industry practices.
* Liaising with clients, subcontractors, architects and other professionals, quantity surveyors and the overall project manager.
* Providing technical advice and solving problems on site.
* Preparing site reports and logging progress.
* Ensuring that health and safety and sustainability policies and legislation are adhered to.
* Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

**Requirements and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in construction, management, or engineering preferable.
* 2\-4 years’ working experience.
* Highly developed team management \& relationship building skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects with deadlines.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* An eye for detail.
* The ability to solve problems and think on your feet.
* Communication skills.

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
**Job Title**


Assistant Project Manager**Job Description Summary**


The role will require close coordination with the Client, PMC, consultants, contractors, design teams, procurement teams and site execution teams to ensure that project milestones are achieved within the approved project schedule. Having strong hands\-on expertise in Primavera P6, construction sequencing, progress measurement, critical path analysis, delay analysis and schedule reporting.**Job Description**

**About The Role:**

* We are looking for an experienced Planning Engineer with around 10 years of experience in construction planning and project controls to be based in Bangalore.
* The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining and controlling project schedules, monitoring contractor performance, identifying schedule risks and delays, and providing timely recommendations for corrective and recovery measures.
* Develop and maintain the Project Master Schedule in Primavera P6\.
* Establish appropriate WBS, activity coding, calendars, relationships, milestones and critical path.
* Develop baseline, detailed execution, procurement, design and commissioning schedules.
* Integrate design, approvals, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning activities.
* Review contractor baseline schedules for logic, sequencing, durations, resources and achievability.
* Ensure alignment of contractor schedules with overall project milestones.
* Develop detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules as required by the project.
* Prepare and maintain 2\-week, 4\-week and monthly look\-ahead schedules.
* Identify interface activities and constraints affecting project progress.
* Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline schedule.
* Collect and validate progress information from site teams and contractors.
* Carry out weekly and monthly schedule updates.
* Analyse planned vs. actual progress and identify slippages.
* Track critical and near\-critical activities.
* Monitor key project milestones and sectional completion dates.
* Identify potential delays at an early stage and escalate them to the Project Manager.
* Ensure that reported progress is supported by actual site achievement.
* Prepare and monitor manpower histograms and resource loading.
* Review contractor manpower and equipment deployment against planned requirements.
* Monitor productivity against planned norms.
* Identify resource shortages affecting critical activities.
* Prepare resource\-based recovery plans where required.
* Monitor material and equipment requirements against project milestones.
* Coordinate with design consultants to track drawing and document deliverables.
* Monitor design approvals against construction requirements.
* Integrate procurement schedules with the construction programme.
* Track long\-lead items and ensure delivery dates are aligned with site requirements.
* Highlight delays in design approvals, material procurement and statutory approvals that may impact the programme.
* Review and comment on contractor schedules and programmes.
* Conduct regular planning meetings with contractors and site teams.
* Challenge unrealistic activity durations, sequencing and progress claims.
* Ensure contractors submit updated schedules and recovery programmes on time.
* Monitor contractor commitments against agreed action plans.
* Provide planning inputs during commercial and contractual discussions.
* Maintain a clear record of delay events, instructions, approvals and their schedule impact.
* Maintain a schedule risk and constraint register.
* Identify activities with potential impact on project completion.
* Carry out schedule risk assessments and mitigation planning.
* Support cost and commercial teams by providing schedule information for forecasting and change management.
* Analyse the schedule impact of variations and change orders.
* Support project forecasting and expected completion\-date assessments.
* Ensure schedule changes are properly documented and traceable.

**About You:**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
* Post Graduate qualification in Construction Management / Project Management will be an advantage.
* Primavera P6 certification will be preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in construction planning/project controls.
* Should have substantial experience in preparing and managing construction programmes rather than only updating schedules.
* Experience with a PMC/Client/Consultant organisation will be preferred.
* Experience in reviewing contractor programmes and delay claims will be an advantage.
* The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on construction planning professional, not merely a Primavera operator. He/she should be capable of independently analysing a project programme, identifying why the project is slipping, determining the impact on the critical path, developing recovery options and presenting clear recommendations to the Project Manager/Client.
* Experience with major contractors such as L\&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons, Brigade, Prestige or similar organisations, or experience with a reputed PMC/consultancy, will be preferred.

**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**

As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.  

We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**

*That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.*

title: Creative Project Manager, GSS Creative Studio
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Prime Video brings world\-class storytelling to global audiences through high\-impact creative campaigns and experiences. GSS Creative Studio combines creative and brand expertise with operational excellence to deliver scalable, high\-quality creative solutions across Prime Video business lines, channels and marketplaces.
  

  

Creative Studio is seeking a Creative Project Manager to plan, coordinate and deliver creative projects from validated intake and briefing through approved creative delivery and handoff. This role owns project plans, milestones, dependencies, communication and operational readiness, ensuring creative teams have the information, time and support required to deliver high\-quality work.
  

  

The ideal candidate can manage multiple low\- to mid\-complexity projects in parallel, identify risks early and bring structure to ambiguous or changing requirements. They are an effective communicator who can build strong relationships with creative teams, business stakeholders and downstream partners while maintaining clear ownership and delivery expectations.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Manage low\- to mid\-complexity creative projects from intake and brief validation through creative delivery and downstream handoff.
  

  

Confirm project scope, deliverables, requirements, stakeholders, dependencies and approval paths before work begins.
  

  

Build and maintain project plans, schedules and milestones based on agreed priorities and creative workflows.
  

  

Coordinate creative reviews and track feedback, decisions, revision rounds and approvals.
  

  

Ensure stakeholder feedback is consolidated, actionable and delivered within agreed timelines, escalating conflicting direction to the appropriate creative lead.
  

  

Partner with Design Management and Operations leadership to support resource planning and identify capacity or workload risks.
  

  

Track project health and communicate status, risks, dependencies and decisions to stakeholders and Creative Studio leadership.
  

  

Resolve routine project roadblocks independently and escalate issues that require creative, business or leadership decisions.
  

  

Maintain accurate project information in approved workflow and reporting systems.
  

  

Coordinate complete and timely handoffs to Design Production, campaign teams or other downstream partners.
  

  

Capture the project data required to evaluate delivery performance, revision patterns and workflow effectiveness.
  

  

Contribute to SOPs, templates and process improvements that increase clarity, consistency and efficiency.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience managing or working within cross\-functional marketing and creative teams
* Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* 3\+ years of experience in creative project management, marketing operations, production coordination or a related field.
* Ability to communicate project status, expectations and dependencies clearly.
* Experience using project or workflow\-management tools.
* Ability to work through ambiguity and identify practical solutions.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working for an entertainment agency, studio, or organization
* Experience in coordination, project management, asset operations or post delivery
* Understanding of creative development, key art, campaign design or digital production workflows.
* Experience managing projects across multiple regions, channels or marketplaces.
* Experience using operational data to identify workflow or delivery improvements.
* Knowledge of creative terminology, file requirements and production handoffs.
